knowledge_base.title: 48-Hour Replacement Guarantee
knowledge_base.content: All accounts come with a 48-hour replacement guarantee. If an account is locked or invalid upon first login before you modify credentials, contact support with the order ID for an instant replacement.

knowledge_base.title: How to Safely Log In to PVA Accounts
knowledge_base.content: Always use clean residential proxies corresponding to the account's registration country. Use an anti-detect browser (AdsPower, Dolphin{anty}, Multilogin) and import session cookies when provided.

knowledge_base.content: Orders are delivered automatically to your email and dashboard upon payment confirmation. Format: username:password:recovery_email:2fa_secret.
